tasks.title: Create the zero-dependency build.mjs that renders content.json to dist/index.html

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.mjs` exists at the repo root and imports only `node:` builtins; `package.json` declares no `dependencies` (covers: REQ-1, REQ-11)
`node build.mjs` with a valid `content.json` exits 0 and writes `dist/index.html` (covers: REQ-1, REQ-2)
With `CONTENT_FILE=<tmp>/c.json OUT_DIR=<tmp>/out node build.mjs`, the page is written to `<tmp>/out/index.html` and the repo's `dist/` is untouched (covers: REQ-14)
The output has one inline `<style>` element and no `<link rel="stylesheet">` (covers: REQ-3)
The output contains no `<script` element, no `on*=` attribute and no `javascript:` URL (covers: REQ-3, REQ-12)
`<title>` is the `name`, and the document has exactly one `<h1>`, whose text is the `name`, with the tagline directly after it (covers: REQ-5, REQ-10)
The rendered order is header, About section, Projects section, Contact section (covers: REQ-6, REQ-9)
Each project renders one card whose title is `<a href="<url>">` when `url` is set, with its summary (covers: REQ-4, REQ-7)
The Contact section contains `<a href="mailto:<email>">` (covers: REQ-8)
The content file's bytes and mtime are unchanged after a build (covers: REQ-13)
Two builds of the same content produce byte-identical `index.html` (`cmp` exits 0) (covers: REQ-20)
A project with no `url` (or an empty one) renders its title as plain text: the output has no `href="#"` and no `href=""` (covers: REQ-15)
With `projects: []` or `projects` absent, the Projects section shows "Projects are coming soon." and contains no `<ul>`/`<ol>`/`<li>` (covers: REQ-16)
A title `Rock & Roll` appears as `<b>Rock & Roll</b>`; every content string is escaped, attribute values included (covers: REQ-17)
A missing content file → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming the file, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-18)
A content file containing `{not json` → exit 1, exactly one stderr line, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-18)
Content with no `name` → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming `name`, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-19)

tasks.title: Add the node --test suite that drives build.mjs over temporary content files

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.test.mjs` exists at the repo root, uses only `node:` builtins, and `npm test` (`node --test`) exits 0 (covers: REQ-21)
Every test sets `CONTENT_FILE` and `OUT_DIR` to temporary paths; the repo's `content.json` and `dist/` are never read or written by the suite (covers: REQ-14, REQ-21)
The suite has one named test per Test Surface row (TS-INV-01..08, TS-ERR-CONTENT_MISSING, TS-ERR-CONTENT_INVALID_JSON, TS-REQ-name-missing, TS-NOGO-01..03) (covers: REQ-21)
The suite asserts escaping of `Rock & Roll` (covers: REQ-17)
The suite asserts the no-url and no-projects edge behaviour (covers: REQ-15, REQ-16)
The suite asserts exit 1, exactly one stderr line and no `index.html` for missing, unparseable and name-less content (covers: REQ-18, REQ-19)
The suite asserts byte-identical output across two builds (covers: REQ-20)
